meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测蛋白质与小分子的结合构象
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是从事药物设计或结构生物学的科研人员
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a researcher in drug design or structural biology

howto.what: 装上后,它能根据你的蛋白质(PDB或序列)和配体(如SMILES/SDF)运行DiffDock,预测配体三维结合姿态,输出带置信度的排序文件;支持批量对接和虚拟筛选,但不预测结合亲和力。
howto.when: 当你说出“分子对接”“预测结合姿态”“虚拟筛选”等指令,或给出PDB文件加配体结构要求预测复合物时触发。

say.text: 用DiffDock把这个配体对接到这个蛋白质上
用这个配体列表跑一批虚拟筛选
say.note: 会准备批量CSV并执行对接。

say.text: 分析一下刚才对接结果的置信度
say.note: 会输出高/中/低置信度统计。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude uses DiffDock to predict 3D binding poses from a protein (PDB or sequence) and a ligand (SMILES/SDF/MOL2), returning ranked poses with confidence scores. It supports batch docking and virtual screening; it does not predict binding affinity.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for molecular docking, binding-pose prediction, virtual screening, or provide a PDB plus a ligand to predict a complex.

say_en.text: Dock this ligand to this protein with DiffDock.
Run virtual screening on this batch of compounds.
say_en.note: Prepares CSV and runs batch docking.

say_en.text: Analyze confidence scores from the docking results.
